meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show real token usage and estimated savings for the current session, read from the session log. Trigger: /caveman-stats.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时查看本次会话的用量与省费估算
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你平时用 AI 助手,想知道每次会话的 token 花费。
copy.tagline_en: See real-time token usage and savings for the current session.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI tools and want to track token spend per session.

howto.what: 输入 /caveman-stats 后，不会得到 AI 正常回复，而是由脚本读取会话日志，直接显示本次会话的 token 实际用量、节省估算、规则开销和净节省。若净节省为负，会如实说明并建议关闭该模式。
howto.when: 当你在对话框输入 /caveman-stats 时触发。

say.text: 运行 /caveman-stats 看看这次会话用了多少 token。
say.note: 立即显示一份统计结果。

say.text: /caveman-stats 显示节省估算和规则开销。
say.note: 会包含净节省，负数会直接标出。

say.text: 再来一次 /caveman-stats 刷新最新数据。
say.note: 每次都会重新读取当前会话日志。

howto.what_en: Typing /caveman-stats blocks the normal model reply and makes a script read the session log, showing the real token usage, estimated savings, rule overhead, and net savings. If net is negative, it says so plainly and suggests turning caveman off.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type /caveman-stats in the input box.

say_en.text: Run /caveman-stats to see how many tokens this session used.
say_en.note: A stats report shows up right away.

say_en.text: /caveman-stats show savings estimate and rule overhead.
say_en.note: Includes net savings; negatives are shown plainly.
It re-reads the current session log each time.
